The '''Iphar system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ipharian-Da'Lor]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Wretched" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Iphar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
